_comment: Tier-2 for ngsolve helmholtz#: pin the NGSolve module-location contract that catalog generators rely on. (a) NewtonCF/MinimizationCF live ONLY in ngsolve.fem (catalog says 'from ngsolve.fem import NewtonCF'). (b) GMResSolver/MinResSolver/BramblePasciakCG live ONLY in ngsolve.krylovspace. (c) Curl/Div (capital) do NOT exist at top level — only lowercase curl/div do, used in template weak forms. (d) solvers.Newton first two positional args are (a, u) where 'a' is the BilinearForm and 'u' is the trial GridFunction — catalog assumes this kwarg name in NL solver patterns. Derived from the new ngsolve_source_scanner.py. Verified empirically against NGSolve 6.2.2604 on 2026-06-01. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): this fixture carries no in-source pathology (it already applies the fix, importing from the submodules), so the control reinstates the pitfall rather than removing it: T2_MUTATE=1 points the lookup handles LOOK_FEM/LOOK_KRY/LOOK_SOL at the top-level ngsolve module instead of ngsolve.fem / ngsolve.krylovspace / ngsolve.solvers. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 5 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 makes the inventories come back as fem_missing=['NewtonCF', 'MinimizationCF'], krylov_missing=['GMResSolver', 'MinResSolver', 'BramblePasciakCG'], solvers_missing=['Newton', 'CG', 'BVP', 'PreconditionedRichardson'], so it removes 'fem_missing=[]', 'krylov_missing=[]', 'solvers_missing=[]' and the fixture goes red. Not covered by the control: 'phantom_at_toplevel=[]' and "newton_first_two_params=['a', 'u']" survive the mutation. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
